node.title: Re^5: Unicode issues with emc uemcli
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
You've wrapped the command in what I think is a anonymous aref along with undef, \my $out.

Yes, all of this is part of the API of [mod://IPC::Run3], its documentation explains it. I used an arrayref because this will cause the module to do its best to [id://1180578|avoid the shell] (which is a [id://1199200|slightly complicated topic on Windows], but at least newer versions of the module will use [mod://Win32::ShellQuote] to help with some of the issues). The undef causes the child process to inherit STDIN from the parent, and \my $out causes the command's STDOUT to be stored in that variable. Then, I use [mod://Encode] to decode the data from the command, which is encoded in UTF-16LE; note that I specify the encoding to simply be UTF-16 because the module is smart enough to use the [wp://Byte order mark|BOM] that is part of the output you showed.
